name: Snowflake
sku: Snowflake Standard edition. Capability that needs the Enterprise edition carries an enterprise-tier constraint, and Business Critical features are not scored. Cortex AI services and Snowpark Container Services are not scored, so derived coverage may understate the platform.

presentation.tagline: Cloud data platform: warehouse, ingestion, governance, ML and apps under one contract.

cost.note: An X-Small warehouse (1 credit/hour) run a few hours a week, plus a small amount of storage ($23/TB/month on AWS US East), at Standard edition's $2/credit.
Third-party estimates put a small analytics team on Standard edition around $250/month; this widens that into a range for steadier use.
Third-party estimate for a mid-size team running regular ETL on Standard edition.
